data.name: Krivansh
data.gender_notes: Krivansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kri- (to create) and Vansh (progeny or lineage). This name signifies the one who brings prosperity and success to his lineage. The name Krivansh carries the meaning “Bringer of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Krivansh usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May you bring prosperity and happiness to your family.
data.etymology: Krivansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Krivansh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Krivansh' has deep cultural roots in Hindu traditions, as it signifies a leader or a patron who brings prosperity and success to his lineage or community. The 'Vansh' or lineage is a significant concept in Hindu culture, often traced back to gods and ancient kings. A name like Krivansh may evoke feelings of pride, leadership, and duty among its bearers. It can also be seen as a reminder of the importance of family and community in Hindu tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name 'Krivansh' carries the meaning of 'creating a prosperous lineage.' This can be interpreted as one's role in the divine plan to contribute to the betterment of their family or community through positive actions, ethical living, and leading by example. The spiritual significance of this name lies in its reminder of the interconnectedness of individuals and the role they play in the grand scheme of the universe. It encourages its bearers to live a virtuous life, build a prosperous and harmonious family, and contribute to the well-being of their larger community.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Krivansh: One whose actions are governed by righteousness and truth, carrying a bow of Dharma to protect and uphold the moral order.

historical_references.reference: The name Krivansh is believed to have originated from the Hindu epic 'Mahabharata'. It is the name of the horse of the Pandava prince Arjuna. Krivansh is also referred to as 'Kumara Sena's horse', suggesting its association with the god Skanda (Kumara).

Another reference to the name Krivansh can be found in the 16th century Puranic text 'Vayu Purana'. In this text, Krivansh is mentioned as the name of a Yaksha (a nature spirit) who was a friend of the god Indra. Krivansh is said to have helped Indra in several battles against his enemies.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Krivansh' is gaining popularity in modern contexts, particularly in the technical, financial, and educational sectors. In technology, it's being used as a username or alias on various platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and Amazon Web Services. This is due to the increasing trend towards using unique and meaningful names for cloud resources and services.
